outcomes: An experimenter can explicitly create an importable Python package with src-layout packaging metadata and a unit test
The generated project opts into the Python extension
The template advertises its experimental, non-default, non-parity boundary in both its catalog metadata and generated README
nonGoals: Providing a stable Python package distribution baseline
Matching the Go library or TypeScript library template capabilities
Generating API, dependency-injection, persistence, or release automation features

requirements.text: The template is selected by its explicit python-library name and declares @putnami/python in the generated project manifest.
The generated project contains a src-layout package, setuptools metadata, and a unit test for the package's exported greeting.
The template's catalog record and generated README state that it is experimental, not default, and has no Go or TypeScript parity promise.
